constraints: Passing a vpAreaName that does not exist raises an error.
If filePath has no path, the document is saved next to the Project folder.
Supported export formats (selected by filePath extension or paramObj.format): .4vp (4D View Pro, default), .xlsx (Excel), .pdf, .txt/.csv (CSV), .sjs (SpreadJS).
If paramObj.format doesn't match filePath's extension, 4D adds/corrects the extension automatically (except CSV, which never gets an appended extension).
paramObj can also specify a callback method invoked when the export completes.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Exports the 4D View Pro object attached to an area to a document on disk, in a format selected by the file extension or explicit export options, optionally invoking a callback on completion.
